description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' polymorphic serialization capabilities, including custom exception serialization, type hierarchy preservation, and roundtrip serialization tests for class hierarchies. It also defines several serializable classes with inheritance and custom serializers.

classes.name: CustomException
classes.description: A custom serializable exception class with support for .NET 8+ serialization info, annotated with [GenerateSerializer] and [Id].

classes.name: PolymorphismTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing polymorphic serialization and type preservation in Orleans, using Xunit framework.

classes.name: SomeBaseClass
classes.description: A serializable base class with two properties, used in serialization hierarchy tests.

classes.name: SomeSubClass
classes.description: A subclass of SomeBaseClass with additional properties, used in polymorphism tests.

classes.name: OtherSubClass
classes.description: Another subclass of SomeBaseClass with different properties, used in hierarchy tests.

classes.name: SomeSubClassChild
classes.description: A further subclass of SomeSubClass demonstrating multi-level inheritance in serialization.

methods.name: ExceptionsAreSerializable
methods.description: Test method verifying exceptions, including custom and aggregate exceptions, serialize and deserialize correctly, preserving data and inner exceptions.

methods.name: GeneratedSerializersRoundTripThroughSerializer_Polymorphic
methods.description: Test roundtrip serialization for polymorphic class instances to ensure correct serialization/deserialization process.

methods.name: GeneratedSerializersRoundTripThroughSerializer_PolymorphicMultiHierarchy
methods.description: Test roundtrip serialization across inheritance hierarchies with multiple subclasses.

methods.name: DeepCopyPolymorphicTypes
methods.description: Tests deep copying of various polymorphic objects to ensure copies are equivalent.

methods.name: RoundTripToExpectedType
methods.description: Helper method to serialize and deserialize an object, then cast to expected type.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object using the DeepCopier service.
